Name: Extra Shop Phone Numbers
Author: PrincessFelicie
Description:
At present, this mod does exactly what it says on the tin -- it adds the travelling cart, Krobus's shop and the Oasis as phone numbers that can be called from the Telephone item obtainable from Robin's shop.

A future update will add a book that needs to be obtained in order to unlock those numbers. Until this is added, consider this an alpha! Functional, but not complete.

Downloads.Description:
Added placeholder configs.
Replaced hard-coded strings with i18n. Mod should now be translatable.
